summary: Frontend-only verification of the universal QuoteCalculator consolidation (Calculator page + QuoteModal). All 10 acceptance criteria pass: pricing math (unit), UI inputs order, prefill behavior, 6-hour floor, range output, deposit=25% of high, piano add/remove, mileage overage label & disappearance at 20mi, elevator informational-only, sales/owner parity, and Help.jsx regression (imports useLivePricing from new location, page loads without errors). Airtable is offline in preview so save was covered by code review only.

issues: Right-side Script Panel's Surcharge Checklist v1.0 lists 'Cushion — 10%' as a bullet. This is internal/crew-facing script content (not the customer-visible quote breakdown, which is compliant), but the product spec says cushion should never be shown — consider dropping the 'Cushion — 10%' bullet from ScriptPanel to fully match the 'cushion is invisible' rule.

critical_code_review_comments: QuoteCalculator.jsx is the single source of truth — QuoteModal.jsx is a thin Dialog wrapper delegating to <QuoteCalculator lead=... />; no duplicated math or inputs. ✓

pricing.js: computeQuote returns quoteLow=ceil(subtotal/50)*50, quoteHigh=ceil((subtotal+cushion)/50)*50, finalQuote===quoteHigh, deposit=round(quoteHigh*25)/100, mileage max(0,miles-20)*0.85, minHours floor via Math.max(hours,minHours). All verified with node unit test.

quoteSaveFields writes range in notes ($low–$high) with legacy single-price fallback; quoteStructuredFields writes {'Crew Size','Est Hours','Deposit Amount'}. Save() first tries base+structured, falls back to base-only on error with a toast — good graceful degradation for Airtable schema mismatch.
saveQuoteBreakdownApi payload confirmed to include: crew, hours (effective, from q.hours), quoteLow, quoteHigh, deposit, elevator (boolean), plus finalQuote and lines. ✓
Help.jsx line 7 imports useLivePricing from '@/components/QuoteCalculator' — page loads for owner without console errors.
Elevator select is informational only (no coupling into computeQuote inputs) — subtotal unchanged when toggled. ✓
Minor: ScriptPanel's Surcharge Checklist still mentions 'Cushion — 10%' visible on Calculator page right column — non-blocking but breaks the strict 'no visible cushion' rule at the page level.
